question: In the fluidized-bed sewage sludge co-incineration, how often were feed packages added to the bed, and what did each package weigh?
expect: one package every 20 s; 2.45 g per package (sec. 2.1, 2.2)
rendered:
<document title="Co-Incineration of Real Municipal Sewage Sludge in a Fluidized Bed: Effects of the Coexistence of P, Fe, and Na on Agglomeration and Heavy Metal Emissions">

=== page 2 ===
- The incineration feedstock was composed of a dried sludge matrix mixed with wood chips and polypropylene (PP) pellets, which were packaged in polyethylene (PE) bags with a total weight of 2.45 g.
- Subsequently, 0.5 mL aliquots of the resulting solution were added to each sludge package.

Answer: Feed packages were added to the bed every 20 seconds, and each package weighed 2.45 grams.
